notes: Baseline SQL001-003 frozen; forward migrations004-017; runtime10 with 94 app tables. Separate identity/app/worker logins, scoped company RLS and restricted installation model-budget functions. Core manifests, reconciliation, immutable cashflow snapshots, settlement workspace revisions, forecast runs, read-only assistant, pinned immutable report editions and private PDF/XLSX/error-CSV exports are implemented. Report approval checks current company permission and exact report edition. Versioned upload/forecast policies, owner retention/archive and dependency-guarded durable source deletion are implemented. Terminal sessions cannot reopen; forecast revisions use new continuation sessions. Analysis claim lease is bounded to ten minutes with token/fence/barrier checks. Validation reports define tested scope; fresh Compose image/organization TLS and live-model integration are not accepted. Provider is not connected to intake classification/mapping/account-role jobs. Migration017 permits provider-specific openai/avalai historical tariffs without changing old requests or runtime version; no live Avalai call is accepted by this metadata.
